description: Puts back the settings a change set replaced, using the undo id from change_settings or change_history. The whole set is undone, or nothing is. It is refused when a setting has changed again since, so a newer choice is never overwritten.

undo_id.description: The undo id, exactly as change_settings or change_history gave it.

name: undo_change
title: Undo a settings change
